description: Issue a password reset token, the same one the site's forgot-password flow issues, and send it as the webhook event account.password_reset_requested to the workspace's webhooks; when the customer's model has account emails on (get_model auth.email.enabled), cmssy also emails the customer itself. The token works for one hour. For an active customer who cannot sign in. Refused for a suspended customer, for one who has not verified yet (use resend_customer_verification), for a customer whose account model has no password sign-in, and after five account requests for the same customer in an hour. `emailDelivery.status` is cmssy's own email: SENT (handed to the email provider), FAILED (not sent - `error` says why, the email log lists it) or OFF (the model leaves emailing to the app). `endpointSubscribed: false` means no enabled webhook endpoint receives the event; with emailDelivery OFF nothing then reaches the customer.
name: send_customer_password_reset
title: Send customer password reset
